# Coastal Inundation and Adaptation Funding

## Executive summary

Adaptation funding has not kept pace with coastal inundation across the Pacific island states. The Green Climate Fund disbursed less than a third of its committed adaptation funding in the last reporting period.

## Findings

Coastal inundation now affects settlements previously considered safe, and adaptation funding decisions are made without reference to the inundation modelling produced by the Bureau of Meteorology.

# Patent Examination Backlog Review

## Executive summary

The patent examination backlog has grown for six consecutive quarters. Examiner recruitment has not matched attrition, and the average pendency of a patent application now exceeds thirty months.

## Findings

Patent examiners report that the classification system is the largest single source of delay. Applications in the biotechnology classes wait longest, and the patent office has no triage process.
